body.name: Joint sharp endpoints
body.construction: For every finite \(\Gamma\ge\Gamma_{\mathrm{feas}}\), define \(L_{\Gamma}=\min_{x\in\mathcal F_{\Gamma}(H)}c_R^{\mathsf T}x\), \(U_{\Gamma}=\max_{x\in\mathcal F_{\Gamma}(H)}c_R^{\mathsf T}x\), and \(\mathcal I_{\Gamma}(H)=[L_{\Gamma},U_{\Gamma}]\).
